facts.fact: Neela asks Devan to stand a night with Bhaskaran's six at the groves before they leave; he shows them the east pair's blind ground under the tallest trunks, and she leaves Bhaskaran, the six and Pavi holding the shed with Thilak kept under a roof.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Neela ask Devan to help guard the groves with Bhaskaran's men.

facts.fact: Devan writes the court case in plain words in his own hand while Neela reads the cipher aloud; Neela carries the ledger back to Kettamala in her saddlebag.
facts.why: needed because the beat has them write the case together and Neela rides back with him.
